acceptance: The rename script below is run EXACTLY ONCE, unchanged, from the repository root. user_request: Mechanical rename: give the transport-generic pieces of the Pi RPC stack neutral names so the Claude transport does not depend on Pi-named types. Identifiers and file names only; zero behavior change.
instructions:
NEVER run git stash, git checkout, git reset, git restore, git clean, git merge, git rebase, git push, git commit, git mv or any command that changes the index, the stash stack, or other worktrees' state. Do NOT touch crates/ajax-web/web/. Do NOT write to /tmp. No `timeout` binary on this host: use the perl alarm form. Do NOT explore and do NOT read the files first. Your FIRST action is running this exact command from the repository root:

python3 - <<'EOF'
import re,os,glob
D="crates/ajax-web/src/adapters/web_session_acp/"
files=sorted(glob.glob(D+"*.rs"))+["crates/ajax-web/sidecar/claude_sdk_sidecar.mjs","crates/ajax-web/tests/fixtures/fake_pi_rpc.js"]
subs=[(r"\bPiRpcProcess\b","JsonlProcess"),(r"\bPiRpcRecord\b","JsonlRecord"),(r"\bPiRpcSession\b","RpcSession"),(r"\bPiStep\b","RpcStep"),(r"\bPiRpcMapping\b","RpcMapping"),(r"\bPiHandshake\b","RpcHandshake"),(r"\bPiModel\b","RpcModel"),(r"\bPiCommand\b","RpcCommand"),(r"\bpi_rpc_process","jsonl_process"),(r"\bpi_rpc_session","rpc_session")]
for f in files:
    s=open(f).read(); t=s
    for a,b in subs: t=re.sub(a,b,t)
    if t!=s: open(f,"w").write(t); print("edited",f)
for old,new in [("pi_rpc_process.rs","jsonl_process.rs"),("pi_rpc_process_tests.rs","jsonl_process_tests.rs"),("pi_rpc_process_bound_tests.rs","jsonl_process_bound_tests.rs"),("pi_rpc_session.rs","rpc_session.rs"),("pi_rpc_session_tests.rs","rpc_session_tests.rs"),("pi_rpc_session_request_tests.rs","rpc_session_request_tests.rs")]:
    os.rename(D+old,D+new); print("renamed",old,"->",new)
EOF

Then `cargo fmt`, then the grep in the acceptance list, then the verify commands. Do not commit.
